evidence.reason: The supplied timer-bound implementation parses only OnCalendar, OnUnitActiveSec, OnUnitInactiveSec, and AccuracySec, then computes the bound as max(intervals) + accuracy. A timer template that declares RandomizedDelaySec can be delayed beyond that bound, so preflight can admit a deadline that systemd may exceed. The smallest compatible repair is to include RandomizedDelaySec in the bound, or to reject timers that declare it.
